CDC calls out manufacturer instructions, material compatibility and training for patient-care equipment cleaning. Exact family example is explicitly named in WHO Medical equipment maintenance programme overview, Appendix B: monitor, ECG; pump, infusion; and anaesthesia/analgesia unit (gas machine), respectively. This supports example inspection procedures, not that any such unit/model is present at RWJ.

data.source_evidence_basis: WHO describes inspection, performance and safety checks, preventive and corrective maintenance, repair follow-up inspection and possible recalibration; its technical series gives examples including ECG monitors, infusion pumps, anesthesia units and X-ray systems. CDC identifies anesthesia breathing circuits as semicritical equipment and states minimum high-level disinfection for semicritical devices contacting mucosa or non-intact skin. Exact family example is explicitly named in WHO Medical equipment maintenance programme overview, Appendix B: monitor, ECG; pump, infusion; and anaesthesia/analgesia unit (gas machine), respectively. This supports example inspection procedures, not that any such unit/model is present at RWJ.

Family-specific asset presence and all local values remain unknown. The named example appears in WHO Appendix B; no target-hospital presence or model is evidenced.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Represent the system as a case-readiness dependency whose exact configuration, gas supply, disposables, reprocessing method, checks and staffing authorization are local/model-specific. Do not infer case capacity or setup time.
